findings.passage: This session, Orr and her fellow conservative republicans passed a record number of Republican priorities, including: Banning Democrat chairs from committees Cutting property taxes with historic relief totaling $51 billion Securing our elections from fraud Defending children by keeping inappropriate materials out of classrooms
findings.note: From her campaign's press release headed 'For Immediate Release June 4, 2025', issued in her name. It lists 'Securing our elections from fraud' among the session's accomplishments. It names no specific ID or citizenship rule.
subjects: election integrity law in general

findings.motion: Co-author of HB 892, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: HB 892 (89th Legislature, 2025) is titled 'Relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote.' The official bill page lists this member among the coauthors. The bill was referred to the House Elections committee on 2025-03-06.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register

findings.motion: House sponsor list on SB 16, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: SB 16 (89th Legislature, 2025) is titled 'Relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote, including the eligibility of certain voters to vote a limited federal ballot if the voter cannot supply the required proof and the procedures for the counting of those ballots; creating criminal offenses.' The official bill page lists this member among the House sponsors; its last action shown is a House committee report sent to Calendars on 2025-05-25.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register
